approvalScope: Planning only; no provider request or execution authorization.

requests.prompt: Medium shot of a customer's hands sliding a driver's license across a polished wood-grain desk surface toward a banker's hands positioned at a keyboard, banker beginning to type, neutral business casual attire visible on both figures from mid-torso down, no faces visible, generic computer monitor edge in frame, soft office lighting, clean professional desk surface
requests.negativePrompt: identifiable faces, real IDs with readable information, specific bank logos, branded materials, cluttered desk, unprofessional setting
requests.requestedDimensions: 1K tier, aspect ratio 16:9; exact pixel dimensions must be read from returned image and accepted/rejected by review.
requests.format: PNG requested; returned content type must be verified.

currentPublishedPrice.qualifier: Promotional 1K price observed 2026-10-02; promotion ends 2026-10-08, after which published price is $0.048 per image; excludes tax.

requests.retry: No retry. Reconcile reservation and receipt before any future attempt.

ownershipTerms.inputLicense: fal Terms grant fal a non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, royalty-free license to process Customer Input to provide the service; customer warrants rights to submitted inputs.
ownershipTerms.outputOwnership: Not established by the reviewed general terms. Model listing says commercial use, which is not treated as a transfer of ownership. Must be clarified before generation.

requests.dependency: The generated ACT3_B005 still from request 1 is used only as the same-beat image-to-video starting frame. It is a required animation-base dependency, not a cross-beat reuse or alias.
requests.approvedVisualDescription: A customer slides ID across a desk to a banker; the banker begins typing.
requests.prompt: Animate only the approved action: a customer’s hands slide an ID across the desk toward a banker’s hands at a keyboard; the banker begins typing. Keep faces outside the frame, use anonymous generic people, and preserve a neutral generic bank workstation with no readable ID information or branding.
requests.negativePrompt: identifiable faces, readable personal data, logos, branded materials, extra people, camera move that changes the approved composition, invented actions
requests.requestedDimensions: 480p tier, 16:9; exact pixel dimensions not guaranteed by the retrieved model documentation and must be measured.
requests.format: Model documentation example returns video/mp4; verify returned content type and actual container.
requests.codec: Not specified by the endpoint listing; inspect with ffprobe before acceptance.
requests.frameRate: Not specified; 150 frames requested, but exact duration cannot be inferred until returned media is probed.
requests.returnedDurationBehavior: Endpoint returns a video URL and file metadata example; no fixed duration or frame-rate guarantee is published. Retrieve only after an authorized request, probe locally, record actual duration/frame count, and reject if outside the approved pilot acceptance window. Do not assume 5 seconds.

currentPublishedPrice.qualifier: Published per generated second on 2026-10-02; billed duration depends on returned output; excludes tax.

requests.retry: No retry. Reconcile reservation and receipt before any future attempt.

ownershipTerms.inputLicense: Same fal input-processing license and customer rights warranties in the general Terms.
ownershipTerms.outputOwnership: Not established by general Terms. Commercial-use label does not prove customer ownership or exclusivity; written clarification required.

cost.capStatus: PROPOSED_ONLY; not confirmed as enforceable by either endpoint. Do not execute unless a verified pre-submit billing control enforces the cap or an explicit revised authorization accepts the unbounded actual duration.
cost.maximumExposure: Not bounded by published endpoint behaviour when actual video duration/FPS is unknown. Two attempts maximum does not itself bound cost.

stopConditions: No execution authorization is included in this proposal.

Stop if price, estimated duration, or maximum charge cannot be established before request within the proposed $0.25 total cap.
Stop if returned still dimensions/format or clip content type/container/codec/frame rate/duration cannot be verified.
No retries; no additional output variation requests.
Human visual approval required before downstream use.
